lines.t: Being born again, restored in His light,
Shaped in the image, made pure in His sight.
A continual washing, day after day,
Cleansed by His mercy, all sin washed away.
Again and again, He makes me new,
A heart made clean, a spirit renewed.
Dying to self, I rise within,
In His love, I’m born again.
If I come in repentance, humble and true,
With sorrow for wrongs, He’ll see me through.
Each tear I shed is a step toward His grace,
Each fall a reminder to seek His face.
Again and again, He makes me new,
A heart made clean, a spirit renewed.
Dying to self, I rise within,
In His love, I’m born again.
Casting off the skin of this world’s disguise,
Walking in His ways, I let the old me die.
Penitent and broken, lifted by His hand,
In the light of His glory, I learn to stand.
Again and again, He makes me new,
A heart made clean, a spirit renewed.
Walking with Him, I’m free from sin,
Until I see glory, born again.
